close_reason: Added if email_ids.len() <= 1 { return; } early exit in sort_thread_email_ids
description: common/mod.rs sort_thread_email_ids (line 95): the function collects all emailIds, looks up receivedAt for each, sorts, and writes back — even for a thread that already has exactly one email. The single-element case is the hot path (every new thread starts here). Suggested rewrite: after collecting email_ids (line 101), add 'if email_ids.len() <= 1 { return; }' before the lookup loop. No logic change; avoids a lock re-acquisition and a sort on a 1-element list for every new import.
title: sort_thread_email_ids lacks early-return for single-element threads
